slot_note: Re-rooted 2026-10-28 in banking-credit-financial-risk / credit-scoring-pd-modeling (Forecasting) at the author's request for a banking task outside the portal list; architecture v3 (payroll-deduction PD) is spent at Gate F and joins v1 and v2 in lineage. The world moves from payroll lending to joint-liability microloans, a ground no card or slot note holds.
niche: a private bank's direct-assignment desk forecasting how many joint-liability-group microloans in a pool an NBFC-MFI offers, every loan current at the cut-off, will be 90 days past due six months on, ten weeks after a cyclone, when co-members are paying each other's instalments at the centre meetings
analyst_test: A strong analyst who rebuilds every loan's days past due from the meeting ledger, reads the group-support postings correctly and applies every filed rule, then reads each pool loan's six-month risk off its own member's payment at the last meeting before the cut-off (carried by the group or paid herself), files about 50 loans 90 days past due on 30 June 2027, a third of the golden 150, because the history's carried members almost always sat alone in groups that kept paying while the pool's carried members after the cyclone often share their group's meeting with a second.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each pool loan's probability of reaching 90 days past due within six months, which joint-liability microlending reads off the loan's group, because co-members pay a short member's instalment until two are short at one meeting and then the whole group stops; with another field's nouns the question loses its object, since no other book's loans are current only because their co-borrowers are paying for them.
layer1: two collection platforms either side of a 2025 core migration, member ids re-keyed through a crosswalk and the group-contribution posting coded GS on the old platform and GRP_CONTRIB on the new
fortnightly centre meetings on each centre's own weekday, rescheduled around holidays, against month-end reporting
the MFI's monthly portfolio report in INR lakh on Indian fiscal-year sheets whose layout changed in FY2025-26
group numbers reused within a centre across loan cycles
credit bureau refresh with masked KYC ids and the same loan reported in two weekly submissions
stakeholder_role: the head of the bank's direct-assignment and priority-sector lending portfolio, who brings the pool's six-month delinquency forecast to the purchase decision

spine.entity: one member's instalment at one centre meeting

world.org_type: private-sector bank buying a pool of joint-liability microloans from an NBFC-MFI (fictional)

driver: A unit's failure is an event of the team it belongs to: teammates absorb one shortfall so the unit's own record looks sound, and the team stops altogether once two shortfalls coincide, so the forward count is the team-state rate by the number of shortfalls being carried at the last contact, applied to every member of each team and measured on the record's own past episodes; read per unit from its own record, or from a past episode's per-unit rates, it misses because how shortfalls cluster within teams differs between episodes.
driver_concrete: In a joint-liability group the co-members pay a short member's instalment, so her loan stays current, and the group stops paying once two members are short at the same meeting, every member's loan then running to 90 days past due; the pool's six-month 90-day count is therefore each group's rate by how many members it carried at its last meeting before the cut-off, from the meeting ledger's own 2023 to 2026 history, times its loans in the pool, where the loan-level roll rate sees no arrears at all and the 2023 flood's rates split by each member's own last payment carry that flood's heavier clustering.
stump: A competent analyst who rebuilds each pool loan's arrears from the meeting ledger, reads the group-support postings correctly and carries the history's six-month 90-day rates by each member's own payment at her last meeting (carried by her group or paid herself) onto the pool files about 50 loans 90 days past due on 30 June 2027 against about 150; the step that lands it there is treating every carried member as carried, when a group carries one short member at a meeting and stops once two are short at the same meeting, every member's loan then running past 90 days.

differentiation.task177: v3 read each loan's default through its own borrower leaving the employer's payroll, an exit hazard per member; here no member's own event decides: a loan defaults because two co-members of its group are short at the same meeting, and the forecast is each group's rate by how many it carried at its last meeting before the cut-off.
differentiation.task116: task116 counts groups eligible for an offer through contracts a register keys to one member (identity and grain on a filed eligibility rule); here nothing is eligible and no key is mis-assigned: a group's loans default together once two members are short at one meeting, a behaviour measured from the meeting ledger's own history.
differentiation.task45: task45 nets a contracted scope against a holding position rebuilt from a movement ledger (positions still carrying an affected unit); here no scope or position: the share is pool loans in groups carrying two or more members at their last meeting, read against a forward default rate measured by that state.
differentiation.task75: task75 finds a second arrival channel as the residual between two internal counts and times it by a recurrence; here nothing is missing from any count and no channel bypasses a gate: every loan is current, and its group's concurrent shortfalls set its forward default.

lineage.niche: a provincial employment service's forecast of the share of jobseekers' own contacts its upgraded digital assistant takes in the eight weeks after an assistant-first period, from each claimant's contact-by-contact channel choices and the outcomes they met
lineage.driver: Experiences a unit did not choose move its later choices far less than experiences it chose, so a period that sends every unit to one option converts few of them; the record holds those imposed experiences only as scattered single episodes, so a learner fitted to the whole record with one rate over-predicts the conversion, and only a separate rate for the imposed experiences, read from those episodes, carries to the period.
lineage.driver_concrete: Jobseekers sent to the digital assistant when the phone queue overflows learn about a fifth as much from it as those who open it themselves, so the eight assistant-first weeks, which send every call to the assistant, lift claimants' own use of it in March and April far less than a reinforcement-learning model with one learning rate predicts.
lineage.stump: One learning rate fitted to every contact and simulated through the assistant-first weeks files about 40 per cent of claimants' own contacts in the assistant for March and April; the overflow-redirected contacts in the record teach about a fifth as much as chosen ones, so the share is about 26 per cent.
lineage.answer: 25 per cent (to the nearest 5 per cent; 25.21 unrounded)
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 Gate F on target.zip 3be16ba3 (2026-10-21): the re-judge was DETERMINISTIC and APPROVE, but scored reader I landed the 25 bin with a fitted outcome-weighted habit model (decay 0.63 per contact, weights by the previous contact outcome) that never separated the imposed contacts; whole per cent had failed determinism and nearest 5 admitted the neighbour, so the lever was no wider than the golden family spread

lineage.niche: a UK news publisher's forecast of the share of its January at-risk list of monthly digital subscribers that a half-price retention offer keeps through March, carried from last January's half-and-half test after billing moved to the 1st of the month
lineage.driver: An intervention moves a unit mainly when it lands in the days before the unit's own recurring decision, so the effect a randomised test measured while those decisions fell at every point of the units' cycles is an average over the cycle, and it does not carry to a delivery that now lands a few days before every unit's decision; only the effect the test read on its units whose decision fell as close to their delivery does.
lineage.driver_concrete: A half-price retention offer keeps a subscriber mainly when it lands in the fortnight before their next monthly bill, so last January's half-and-half test, sent while bills fell on every day of the month, kept about 9 in 100 across the cycle, while this January's list, every bill on 1 February six days after the send since billing moved to the 1st, is kept at the rate the test measured on subscribers billed within two weeks of it, about 20 in 100.
lineage.stump: An uplift model on last January's half-and-half test (two-model or transformed outcome on the subscriber features) scored on this year's list files about 10 per cent; the test's subscribers whose next bill fell within two weeks of the send were kept at about twice the overall rate and almost none of the rest, and every bill on this year's list falls six days after the send, so the share is about 20 per cent.
lineage.fate: RETIRED 2026-10-22 at stage 4 after the author's final ask pass: the call held in every blind read (readers A to E filed the default 10 per cent) and the round 3 re-judge was DETERMINISTIC and APPROVE on target.zip c2789bda, but the asks never cleared two readers in one round (round 1: 9 and 21 of 21; round 2: 0 and 9; round 3: reader E 12 of 21, keeping ask B through the filed qty convention); an ask device whose determinism needs a filed convention dies when the convention is filed

lineage.driver: A unit reaches the outcome almost only through one event, leaving the body that collects its payments while its obligation is still open, so its rate over a window is that event's rate times the share of such events that convert; the record's units leave rarely, and the ones that leave often hold obligations set to end before they go, so a model of the outcome on the units' own attributes reads the rarity of the event as their quality, while the forward units belong to bodies whose own payment records show them leaving several times as often.
lineage.driver_concrete: A payroll-deduction loan defaults almost only when its borrower leaves the employer's payroll while the loan is open, about 55 in 100 such loans reaching 90 days past due within months, so the public-servant book's first-year default of under 2 per cent is the rarity of permanent staff leaving, temporaries' loans being capped to end before their contracts; the private employers' own monthly payroll registers show their staff leaving five to six times as often, so about 250 of the 2,400 launch loans default by 31 January 2028, not the 50 a PD model on borrower attributes scores.
lineage.stump: A PD model fitted on the public book's borrower attributes and scored on the launch file gives about 50 of the 2,400 loans in default by 31 January 2028; the public book's defaults run almost wholly through borrowers leaving the payroll with the loan open, which the private employers' payroll registers show five to six times as often, so the count is about 250.
lineage.niche: a public servants' savings and credit cooperative forecasting how many of the first payroll-deduction loans it disburses to members employed by private firms will be in default a year later, from ten years of payroll loans to public-servant members and the monthly payroll registers the private employers send under their deduction agreements
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-23 at stage 4 on Gate F (target.zip 2db9de82): a blind reader landed the call 7 of 7 from the employers' payroll exits and the public pass-through; payroll exit as the default channel is field knowledge

notes: Architecture v4 (2026-10-28). stump_strategy binding_constraint: a joint-liability group's capacity is one carried member per meeting, a limit the member-level reading double-books when two co-members are short at the same meeting; composition_mix was weighed and set aside because it names the estimator (a rate by state) rather than the step (the shared per-meeting limit). Pattern C: the decisive quantity is the share of pool loans whose group carried two or more at its last meeting, built behind the join of the pool tape to the meeting ledger, never a column. Gate G binding_constraint: the limit itself moves the forecast, every member of an over-limit group defaulting. Forcing event: the bank books the pool by 31 March 2027 for its priority-sector return for FY2026-27.
